items.name: Kunci lemah — prima berdekatan (Fermat), p−1 smooth (Pollard), faktor bersama (batch-GCD), ROCA
refs: Heninger, Durumeric, Wustrow, Halderman — Mining Your Ps and Qs, USENIX Security 2012
Nemec et al. — The Return of Coppersmith's Attack (ROCA), CCS 2017

items.name: Eksponen privat kecil (Wiener / Boneh–Durfee)
refs: Wiener — Cryptanalysis of Short RSA Secret Exponents, IEEE TIT 1990

items.name: Faktorisasi GNFS
refs: Boudot et al. — Comparing the difficulty of factorization and discrete logarithm: a 240-digit experiment, CRYPTO 2020

items.name: Eksponen publik kecil tanpa padding (Håstad / Coppersmith)
items.status: praktis pada textbook RSA; dimitigasi OAEP

items.name: Manger's attack (oracle galat dekripsi OAEP)
refs: Manger — A Chosen Ciphertext Attack on RSA OAEP as Standardized in PKCS #1 v2.0, CRYPTO 2001

items.name: Bleichenbacher / ROBOT (fallback PKCS#1 v1.5)
refs: Böck, Somorovsky, Young — ROBOT, USENIX Security 2018

items.name: Invalid-curve / kunci publik tidak tervalidasi
refs: Biehl, Meyer, Müller — Differential Fault Attacks on Elliptic Curve Cryptosystems, CRYPTO 2000
Jager, Schwenk, Somorovsky — Practical Invalid Curve Attacks on TLS-ECDH, ESORICS 2015

items.name: Perbandingan tidak constant-time (memcmp pada tag/MAC/padding)
refs: Lawson — Timing attack in Google Keyczar, 2009

items.name: Material kunci tidak di-zeroize (sisa di memori / cold boot)
refs: Halderman et al. — Lest We Remember: Cold Boot Attacks, USENIX Security 2008

items.name: Timing attack pada modular exponentiation
refs: Brumley & Boneh — Remote Timing Attacks are Practical, USENIX Security 2003

items.name: Transient execution (Spectre)
refs: Kocher et al. — Spectre Attacks, IEEE S&P 2019

items.name: Frequency-scaling side-channel (Hertzbleed)
refs: Wang et al. — Hertzbleed, USENIX Security 2022
